description.zh: 应用的ID标识串（PID）。多个PID以半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The process identifier (PID) of the application. Separate multiple PIDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
打开或关闭一个或多个应用的Agent总开关。关闭开关后即停止监控。如果不填写该参数，则表示查询目标应用当前的Agent总开关状态。

- `true`：打开Agent总开关
- `false`：关闭Agent总开关
description.en:
Specifies whether to turn on or off the main switch of the ARMS agent. The monitoring stops after the switch is turned off. If you do not specify this parameter, the main switch status of the ARMS agent is queried.

*   `true`: turns on the switch
*   `false`: turns off the switch

description.zh: 应用类型，目前仅支持设置为**TRACE**。
description.en: The type of the application. Set the value to **TRACE**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms config-app --app-ids iioe7jcnuk@582846f37000000,atc889zkcf@d8deedfa9bf000000 --enable true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --type TRACE --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms ConfigApp --region cn-hangzhou --Type TRACE --Enable true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppIds 'iioe7jcnuk@582846f37000000,atc889zkcf@d8deedfa9bf000000'
